thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: high-alert-rate detected for service=inference-router (group=alerts) — 220 alerts in 5m, PagerDuty triggered

sam oncall: saw it, I'm paged. looking now. quick check: any customer-facing 5xxs?

olivia sre: not seeing a rise in 5xxs from the public LB logs — mostly internal queue timeouts + retry storms from batching. likely noise from a retry loop.

jin platform: can confirm spike aligns with a config roll for batched inference at 06:12 UTC — there was a wrong timeout escalation in the client lib.

sam oncall: ok, mitigation plan: 1) route new alerts to a temporary high-rate dedupe channel, 2) raise grouping window to 10m for this rule, 3) create a short silence on PD for noisy fingerprints. anyone object?

mike pagerduty: agree. I'll create a PD suppression with scope=service:inference-router for 15m while we stabilize. will note incident id in the suppression.

laura product: customer-facing impact? any active sessions dropped? we need to notify accounts if user-visible.

olivia sre: user-facing error rate is flat. latency blips for long-tail sequences but no widespread session failure. recommend a small announcement only if we detect customer retries > 1%.

jin platform: quick alert rule tweak (proposed):
```
expr: increase(alert_count[5m]) > 100 and sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=router,code!~"5.."}[5m])) < 10%
labels: severity=info, dedupe_key=router_retry_fingerprint
```
This will keep the signal but downgrade noisy bursts to info and attach a dedupe key.

sam oncall: that looks good. I'll apply the temporary rule in the alerting config and push a re-eval. tagging infra-rollout as cause.

mike pagerduty: PD suppression active (15m). I've rerouted the existing PD incidents to the dedupe group. please add a note once we decide permanent changes. :thumbsup:

olivia sre: also adding a dashboard slice: "inference-router: alert signal curation" — includes alerts/sec, dedupe_key distribution, retried request percentage, avg queue time. this will help post-incident triage.

sam oncall: doing the handoff to olivia for cleanup and follow-ups. sam offshift in 20m. action items: 1) olivia to validate dedupe_key correctness and retention (due EOD), 2) jin to PR client-lib rollback + fix timeout (due ASAP), 3) mike to propose PD grouping rules (tomorrow), 4) laura to draft optional customer note if retries cross threshold (monitoring).

laura product: on it — I'll draft a short note template. if we stay <1% retries, we hold.

jin platform: PR opened with fix, marking for fast-track. I'll also add a small metric: client_retry_origin to help classify future bursts.

olivia sre: I've created the dashboard slice and a short runbook section: "if alerts/sec > 150 and 5xxs < 2% then enable PD suppression + increase grouping window to 10m; if 5xxs >= 2% escalate to SEV-2." adding to the eng-runbooks repo.

sam oncall: thanks team. leaving notes in the incident tracker. we'll reconvene for post-incident review tomorrow and decide persistent alerting rule changes (dedupe TTL, grouping windows, PD routing). :white_check_mark:
